messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [INCIDENT] kubelet eviction + node disk pressure on cluster-us-west-2 (gpu-23). Pager routed to oncall.
ashley: I got the page — what's up?
mike: node gpu-23 ephemeral-storage at 100%. Kubelet started evicting pods: modelcache-serve and some infra helpers.
jordi: before the evictions we saw runtime signs: repeated 'CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED' and containers hitting OOMKilled during warmup. Looks like heavy disk I/O + memory churn.
ashley: is there customer impact?
lee: metrics — spike in 502/504 between 09:18-09:28 UTC. ~2% of total requests, concentrated on generation-heavy customers. CS flagged IDs 432 and 559.
mike: quick node check: /var/lib/model_cache/checkpoints contains three massive files: "ckpt.2026-03-15.01.48" (112G), "ckpt.2026-03-15.01.20" (60G), "ckpt.tmp" (48G partially written). Disk consumed by checkpoints + debug logs.
jordi: we rolled async checkpointing back on in last deploy (b9f3). GC wasn't running because modelcache crashed mid-write, leaving large partial files.
ashley: timeline and immediate action?
deploy-bot: deploy b9f3 -> cluster-us-west-2/modelcache at 2026-03-15T09:12:10Z.
mike: cordoned gpu-23. Attempted drain but pods already evicted. Will cleanup partial files; recommending stop modelcache process first.
jordi: caution — other nodes may reference shared files. We should move incomplete ckpt to /tmp and restart modelcache, not blind-delete.
nashley: can we free space fast enough to stop more evictions?
mike: yes. On node: `sudo systemctl stop modelcache.service` -> removed `/var/lib/model_cache/checkpoints/ckpt.tmp` and rotated logs. Freed ~160G. Node now at ~48% ephemeral-storage.
oncall: fast command list you ran?
mike: ran:```bash
kubectl describe node gpu-23 | egrep -i "ephemeral|evict"
sudo systemctl stop modelcache.service
sudo rm -rf /var/lib/model_cache/checkpoints/ckpt.tmp
sudo journalctl -u modelcache -n 200 > /tmp/mcache_logs
sudo logrotate /etc/logrotate.d/modelcache
```
jordi: restarted modelcache pods with env override to disable checkpointing: `kubectl set env deployment/modelcache CHECKPOINT_WRITE=false -n prod` and scaled replicas down to reduce I/O. Also restarted container runtime on affected node to clear cgroups.
ashley: did the CUDA errors stop?
jordi: no further CUBLAS failures in the past 6 minutes. OOMKilled events stopped after freeing disk and disabling checkpointing.
lee: Customer impact summary to include in message: ~10 minutes elevated errors starting 09:18 UTC, heavy-gen customers impacted, approx 2% of requests had errors, no persisted data loss observed. CS will draft outreach.
ashley: proposed mitigations:
- rollback or patch to disable async checkpointing (short-term)
- ensure checkpoints go to PVC/obj-storage, not node ephemeral (medium)
- add initContainer cleanup for old tmp files and stricter logrotate (short)
- tune ephemeral-storage alerts and node thresholds (short)
- add modelcache GC and crash-safe checkpoint writes (long)
jordi: PR #4829 toggles CHECKPOINT_WRITE default off and adds GC hook — ready to roll.
mike: applied `kubectl set env` and scaled modelcache: `kubectl scale deployment/modelcache --replicas=2 -n prod` then `--replicas=1` to force pod relocation while I/O quieted. Deployed logrotate config to node pool.
deploy-bot: rollout of config change started, status: 3/3 updated -> 3/3 :white_check_mark:.
ashley: monitoring now?
jordi: disk usage stable across pool, no new eviction events. Latency returned to baseline for majority traffic.
lee: CS note: initial message sent to impacted accounts, follow-up scheduled postmortem.
ashley: quick post-incident assignments: jordi -> implement checkpoint to PVC + GC; mike -> node alert tuning and automatic cleanup script; lee -> customer comms + impact recap. Mark severity P2 and schedule postmortem.
ashley: linking runbook: https://internal.redwood/docs/runbooks/ephemeral-storage-eviction :wrench:
mike: short-term mitigation also included adding `tmp-cleanup` initContainer in the modelcache daemonset to prune `/var/tmp` older than 2h. Rolling to prod pool.
jordi: long-term: stream checkpoints directly to S3-compatible storage, write-atomic uploads, and ensure crash-resume instead of partial local ckpt writes.
ashley: oncall handoff in 30m — I'll monitor, then hand to next oncall. Please add any remaining notes.
oncall: note for handoff: root cause = async checkpointing to node-ephemeral + unrotated debug logs -> tmp fill -> kubelet eviction -> pod restarts -> cold-start CUDA alloc failures -> cascading restarts. Remediations applied.
incident-bot: Incident annotated as mitigated. Please file postmortem when ready. :memo:
